request_summary: Run the GEC suite on DEV after the review fixes, with a direct report on failure.

actions.description: Statically inspected the configuration, secret resolver mode and previous runs, then presented one exact plan with effects and asked for approval and a failure policy; delegated only after both were given.
Prepared ACE delegation manifests before delegating, then delegated the run to QA-runner with the approved plan and no rerun budget.

Diagnosed the blocker from the runner result and git history: the missing Key Vault secret name comes from an earlier commit that replaced a hardcoded table endpoint with a secret reference; it is unrelated to the review fixes.

outcome.detail: The run was blocked before any scenario, so the review fixes remain unverified at runtime; the blocker is a configuration choice that needs a human decision.

notes: No rerun or fix attempt was made, per the direct-report policy. No remote state was changed, since before_all failed before any setup.
